notes.title: Tomoyo After 1.2.1 Update
notes.content:
A new minor patch for Tomoyo After has been released. This update is expected to function with saves from the previous version, version 1.2.0, without any issues.

As always, you can switch back to the previous versions at any time in the game's properties if you are experiencing difficulties with your game saves.

The patch notes are as follows:

Version 1.2.1 Patch notes

Fixed several textual errors in Dungeon & Takafumis (Thanks to VyseGolbez for reporting these errors!)
Fixed a bug that prevented the "Seasoned warrior" achievement from unlocking if the character levels up to level 99 with experience points that are awarded for the time bonus (Thanks to JacobARF for bringing this issue up)
ːfukoː

notes.title: Tomoyo After 1.2.0 Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We have released a new update for Tomoyo After today. The new update, version 1.2.0, adds Steam Leaderboards support for Dungeons and Takafumis. Specifically, the leaderboard ranks you and your friends based on the number of days used to complete a Dungeons and Takafumis playthrough, thereby giving you extra Key bragging rights.

In addition to this, we have also added an extra Steam profile background featuring Tomoyo, courtesy of community member Botan.

As for those of you who fulfilled all of the requirements but had trouble with the Full Mastery achievement on versions 1.1.x, the achievement should now unlock automatically the next time you return to the ground level as well.

As always, you can always switch back to the previous versions at any time in the game's properties.

Finally, if you haven't already, please be sure to check out Key's latest title, [strike]Onion Cutting Simulator 2016[/strike] Harmonia.

Patch notes

 Added Steam leaderboards support
 Fixed a bug that prevented the "Full mastery" achievement from unlocking. If you fulfill the requirements, the achievement will unlock automatically when you return to the ground level; job skills do not need to be unlocked again
 Fixed a punctuation error

notes.title: Original Soundtrack and Trading Cards now available!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I am excited to announce that the Tomoyo After Original Soundtrack has been released on the Steam Store! This release features all 21 tracks from the visual novel in both lossless FLAC and MP3 formats, and is currently available for $2.99, 40% off its normal price, until September 19th (PST). What's more, the base game will also receive a 30% week-long discount beginning on September 12th at 10:00 am (PST)!

To go along with all this good news, we have also added Steam trading cards for Tomoyo After! ːfukoː By [strike]idling[/strike] actively playing the game, you will receive a card every 45 minutes. Be sure to collect all of the cards and get awesome Tomoyo backgrounds for your Steam profile or the ability to summon Fuko in your Steam chat!

Also released today is the Version 1.1.2 update, which fixed a small number of typos and missing periods/full stops. Just like the previous update, you can switch back to the previous releases at any time in the game's properties.

Edit: Had a bit of hiccups with the configuration, but the soundtrack should be downloadable now! We apologize for any inconvenience caused.

Patch notes

 Enabled Steam trading cards for aspiring Steam Fuko Masters
 Fixed a number of typos

notes.title: Tomoyo After 1.1.0 Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We are happy to announce that we will be releasing a new update of Tomoyo After ~It's A Wonderful Life~. The new update, version 1.1.0, fixes several textual errors and a bug that prevented the D&T achievement "Full mastery" from logging unlocked job skills correctly.

The update is now available on the "update" branch accessible in Properties > Betas. It will remain as an optional update for a week until August 12th, 2016 (PST). It will then be switched over to the default branch and be made available by default.

If you encounter any problems with your game saves after switching to the "update" branch, you may wish to switch to the "release - Original release" branch and continue your current playthrough with the original version. This version will remain accessible even after the update is made default on August 12th.

This update will take place right before Kazamatsuri's Tomoyo After bookclub. If you wish to read along with other members of the community and haven't yet started, it is recommended that you switch to the "update" branch before you begin!

You can find additional details on the update in the bottom of this announcement.

Trading cards

We are also happy to announce that we are working on a set of Steam trading cards for Tomoyo After. We are aiming to release the trading cards next month.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25517727/62a153b0deef8f72fd50028cbe3242cc8220bb90.png

Patch notes

    Fixed a number of textual errors
    Fixed a bug that prevented job skill unlocks from being logged. Please note that some skills will need to be unlocked again in either existing or new D&T saves for the "Full mastery" achievement to unlock.
